stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[3].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

set_budget.statement: set-budget CATEGORY AMOUNT stores a positive monthly budget for the category in the JSON file, replacing any earlier one.

add_expense.statement: add AMOUNT CATEGORY [--date] [--note] appends an expense with amount, category, date and note to the JSON file.

unknown_category.statement: add with a category that has no budget exits 2, names the category on stderr and leaves the file unchanged.

invalid_amount.statement: Zero, negative, non-numeric, NaN, infinite or more-than-2-decimal amounts exit 2 and leave the file unchanged, for both add and set-budget.

report.statement: report [--month YYYY-MM] prints, for each budgeted category, spent, budget and percent, counting only expenses dated in that month.
must_include: spending report per category against budget

alert_80.statement: A category with spent >= 80% and < 100% of budget prints a WARNING in report and after add; below 80% prints none.

alert_100.statement: A category with spent >= 100% of budget prints an EXCEEDED alert in report and after add.

single_file_stdlib.statement: budget_tracker.py imports only standard library modules and works as a single file.
